{{armor art infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Spectacles | pvpreward = Basic | specialgallery = Spectacles }} '''Spectacles''' is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the [[Asura rank|Asura title track]] to be able to craft this armor.
